notes: Harness commit 64f3d5346820040db8b215b0b76b3ed23c5502ce. No product code, no new dependency, no new pnpm script. Raw smoke logs: campaign/logs/P2-IMPL-LOCAL-RUN/ (ignored).

Deviation: the S3 stand-in is SeaweedFS (chrislusf/seaweedfs by digest), not MinIO, because minio/minio and quay.io/minio/minio are no longer pullable. The storage probe is PASS only when the bucket lists an object written by the app (no access log); otherwise UNVERIFIED. The SeaweedFS path was not exercised in the real-Docker smoke (storage=false); only unit-tested with fakes.

Deviation: dbWrite counts rows outside known migration bookkeeping tables (_prisma_migrations, django_migrations, etc.), stricter than design.md, so a migration alone cannot pass it. Framework seed rows (e.g. Django content types) still count.
Deviation: no separate worker container probe (manifest facts have no worker field); redis probe checks CLIENT LIST (a client other than the probe) or DBSIZE > 0.

Deviation: a failed migration is a run-stage FAIL (failure=migration) and the probes stage is SKIPPED; the migration probe records PASS/FAIL only when the app started. run and probes are one resume unit (open one redoes both).

classifyLocal gains local-unverified (all stages PASS but a probe UNVERIFIED). runLocalBuild now returns early on resume when no stage is open, so a finished repo whose image was removed by cleanup is not rebuilt. inputsHash config now includes the dependency image digests. Cleanup is SKIPPED when no build was attempted.

Stage A --resume: skips an entry whose <runs-dir>/<id>.json has the same deployzSha, analysisVersion, commit and ai.mode; kept results are included in the summary. Stage A has no containers, so no reconcile step applies there.
Pre-existing, not touched: eslint reports two unused imports in scripts/repository-deployment/evidence.ts.
